name: coding-challenge-36-pong
description: Pong clone with a pure, deterministic game-logic core (Node + browser canvas).

scripts.build: npm run build:tsc && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test test/physics.test.ts test/paddle.test.ts test/ai.test.ts test/serve.test.ts test/game.test.ts
